description: Send one user message to the agent in a manual conversation and wait for its reply, the way a test run reaches it. Returns the conversation with the new reply. A conversation holds at most 50 messages. Scoring covers the messages sent before it started; score again after more.

text.description: The user's message, sent to the agent as written.
text.title: Text
